name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot is a leading CRM platform that provides marketing, sales, content management, and customer service software. Founded in 2006 at MIT, HubSpot pioneered inbound marketing and serves over 200,000 customers across 135 countries. The platform unifies marketing automation, CRM, sales pipeline, and support into a single ecosystem used by businesses from startups to enterprises.

name: Salesforce
description: Salesforce is the world's leading CRM platform, connecting companies and customers through a unified cloud-based suite covering sales, service, marketing, commerce, and analytics. Founded in 1999 by Marc Benioff, Salesforce pioneered cloud computing and SaaS delivery. With over $34B in annual revenue, it serves over 150,000 businesses globally including 90% of the Fortune 500.

name: Stripe
description: Stripe is a global financial infrastructure platform that enables businesses to accept payments and manage their finances online. Founded in 2010 by brothers Patrick and John Collison, Stripe processes hundreds of billions of dollars annually for millions of businesses — from startups to Fortune 500 companies. Its APIs power payment processing, billing, fraud prevention, and banking-as-a-service across 195 countries.

name: Snowflake
description: Snowflake is the AI Data Cloud company, enabling organizations to mobilize their data by eliminating silos and providing a single unified platform for data warehousing, data lakes, data engineering, data science, and data application development. Founded in 2012, Snowflake operates across all major cloud providers and serves over 9,800 customers including 639 of the Forbes Global 2000.

name: Datadog
description: Datadog is the monitoring and security platform for cloud applications, bringing together end-to-end traces, metrics, and logs to make your applications, infrastructure, and third-party services entirely observable. Founded in 2010, Datadog serves over 29,000 customers across more than 100 countries, with the majority of Fortune 500 companies relying on it for infrastructure and application performance monitoring.

name: Revolut
description: Revolut is a global neobank and financial super-app offering retail banking, currency exchange, stock trading, cryptocurrency, and business accounts. Founded in 2015 by Nikolay Storonsky and Vlad Yatsenko in London, Revolut has grown to over 50 million personal customers and 500,000 business customers across 38 countries. The company holds banking licenses in multiple jurisdictions and processes over $100 billion in transactions annually.

name: Personio
description: Personio is Europe's leading HR platform for small and medium-sized businesses, serving over 15,000 customers across Europe. Founded in Munich in 2015 by Hanno Renner, Personio automates core HR processes including recruiting, onboarding, payroll, time tracking, and performance management. Backed by top investors including Accel and Index Ventures, Personio is valued at over €8 billion and operates across Germany, UK, Spain, Netherlands, Ireland, and France.

name: Grab
description: Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp, operating across ride-hailing, food delivery, package delivery, mobile payments, and financial services across 8 countries. Founded in Malaysia in 2012 by Anthony Tan and Tan Hooi Ling, Grab serves millions of users daily across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, Myanmar, and the Philippines. Its GrabPay fintech arm serves over 35 million users.

name: Razorpay
description: Razorpay is India's leading full-stack financial solutions company, offering payment gateway, payment links, payment pages, subscriptions, and business banking (RazorpayX) to over 8 million businesses. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar, IIT Roorkee alumni, Razorpay processes over $60 billion in annual transactions. The company is valued at $7.5 billion and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Tiger Global, and GIC.

name: Freshworks
description: Freshworks provides SaaS customer and employee engagement software for businesses of all sizes. Founded in Chennai, India in 2010, the company offers Freshdesk (customer support), Freshsales (CRM), Freshservice (ITSM), and Freshchat (messaging). Freshworks serves over 67,000 customers across 120 countries including Bridgestone, Chargebee, and Daimler. Listed on NASDAQ in 2021, it was the first SaaS company from India to IPO in the US.

name: Atlassian
description: Atlassian is a global technology company building products that help teams collaborate and build software. Founded in Sydney, Australia in 2002, Atlassian's flagship products include Jira (project and issue tracking), Confluence (team wiki), Trello (visual project management), and Bitbucket (Git hosting). With over 10 million active users across 300,000 customers worldwide, Atlassian serves the full spectrum of software development teams — from individual developers to the world's largest enterprises.
